0022600088.text: Both the Toronto Raptors and Chicago Bulls open their 2026-27 seasons, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Raptors a 75% chance to win. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, while Chucky Hepburn (hamstring), Jakob Poeltl (rest) and RJ Barrett (rest) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Chicago's list includes Isaac Okoro (undisclosed), Nic Claxton (hamstring), Tobe Awaka (knee) and Zach Collins (toe, surgery), all day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18.
